pairs: In the third year of the reign of Belshazzar the king,
post id quod videram in principio,
After that which I had seen in the beginning, I, Daniel,
that I was in the capital city of Susa,
which is in the region of Elam,
vidi autem in visione esse me super portam Ulai.
yet I saw in the vision that I was over the gate of Ulai.
Et levavi oculus meos, et vidi:
And I lifted up my eyes and saw,
et ecce aries unus stabat ante paludem,
and behold, a single ram stood before the marsh,
et unum excelsius altero atque succrescens. Postea
and one was higher than the other and growing higher still.
vidi arietem cornibus ventilantem contra occidentem,
After this, I saw the ram brandishing his horns against the West,
et omnes bestiæ non poterant resistere ei,
and all the beasts could not withstand him,
nor be freed from his hand,
and he did according to his own will,
ecce autem hircus caprarum veniebat ab occidente super faciem totius terræ,
a he-goat among she-goats came from the West above the face of the entire earth,
and he did not touch the ground.
porro hircus habebat cornu insigne inter oculos suos.
Furthermore, the he-goat had a preeminent horn between his eyes.
Et venit usque ad arietem illum cornutum,
And he went all the way to the ram that had the horns,
which I had seen standing before the gate,
et cucurrit ad eum in impetu fortitudinis suæ.
and he ran towards him in the force of his strength.
And when he approached near to the ram,
et non poterat aries resistere ei:
and the ram could not withstand him,
and when he had cast him down on the ground,
et nemo quibat liberare arietem de manu ejus.
and no one was able to free the ram from his hand.
Hircus autem caprarum magnus factus est nimis:
But the he-goat among she-goats became exceedingly great,
et orta sunt quatuor cornua subter illud per quatuor ventos cæli.
and four horns were rising up beneath it by means of the four winds of heaven.
De uno autem ex eis egressum est cornu unum modicum:
But from one of them came forth one little horn,
et factum est grande contra meridiem,
and it became great against the Meridian,
Et magnificatum est usque ad fortitudinem cæli:
And it was magnified even towards the strength of heaven,
and it threw down those of the strength
Et usque ad principem fortitudinis magnificatum est:
And it was magnified, even to the leader of the strength,
et ab eo tulit juge sacrificium,
and it took away from him the continual sacrifice,
and cast down the place of his sanctuary.
Robur autem datum est ei contra juge sacrificium propter peccata:
And the advantage was given to him against the continual sacrifice, because of the sins,
and truth will be struck down to the ground,
Et audivi unum de sanctis loquentem:
And I heard one of the holy ones speaking,
et dixit unus sanctus alteri nescio cui loquenti:
and one saint said to another, (I know not to whom he was speaking,)
“What is the extent of the vision,
et peccatum desolationis quæ facta est:
and the sin of the desolation, which has happened,
and of the sanctuary and the strength, which will be trampled?”
and so the sanctuary will be cleansed.”
Factum est autem cum viderem ego Daniel visionem,
But it came to pass, when I, Daniel,
saw the vision and sought understanding that,
ecce stetit in conspectu meo quasi species viri.
behold, there stood in my sight something like the appearance of a man.
Et audivi vocem viri inter Ulai:
And I heard the voice of a man within Ulai,
make this one understand the vision.”
And he came and stood next to where I was standing,
et stetit juxta ubi ego stabam:
quoniam in tempore finis complebitur visio.
for in the time of the end the vision will be fulfilled.”
And when he spoke to me,
I fell forward onto the ground,
et statuit me in gradu meo,
Ego ostendam tibi quæ futura sunt in novissimo maledictionis:
“I will reveal to you what the future things are in the earlier tribulation,
for the time has its end.
which you saw to have horns,
is the king of the Medes and Persians.
Porro hircus caprarum, rex Græcorum est;
Furthermore, the he-goat among she-goats is the king of the Greeks,
is the same one, the first king.
Quod autem fracto illo surrexerunt quatuor pro eo:
And since, having been shattered, there grew four in its place,
quatuor reges de gente ejus consurgent,
four kings will rise up from his people,
there will arise a king of shameless face
And his advantage will be strengthened,
but not by his kind of force,
and other than what he will be able to trust,
And he will execute the successful
and the people of the saints,
et dirigetur dolus in manu ejus:
and treachery will be guided by his hand.
And his heart will be inflated,
et in copia rerum omnium occidet plurimos:
and by the abundance of everything he will kill many,
and he will rise up against the Lord of lords,
and he will be knocked down without a hand.
And the vision of the evening and the morning,
you must seal the vision, because,
after many days, it will occur.”
languished and was sick for some days,
and when I had lifted myself up,
and I was astonished at the vision,
and there was none who could interpret it.
